correctness.rationale: For every prime \(p>3\), equality of the first three power sums of two triples determines the three elementary symmetric functions by Newton identities, hence the triples are orderings of the same multiset. The three multiplicity types contribute \(36\binom p3+9p(p-1)+p=p(6p^2-9p+4)\). Chinese remaindering multiplies these counts over squarefree moduli, and substitution into the cited affine-transitivity synthesis identity gives the displayed \(\mathcal C_6\). Since each local factor lies in \([109/25,6)\), the cubic endpoint constant tends to zero exactly when \(\omega(N)\to\infty\). Fresh brute-force counts at \(p=5,7\) reproduced the local formula and fiber multiplicities.
risks: The proof deliberately excludes primes 2 and 3 and nonsquarefree moduli; no ramified local factor is claimed.
